iteration_reason: Seven v1 GPU controls at 4290 show useful skin/gold changes, but the front white sleeve is already on the bright ramp endpoint and became slightly darker. Preserve HSV boundaries; add palette-gated white midtone gain with luminance headroom, and soften hair's brown side band. Iteration 2 awaits new static controls.
source_contract: Only the saved production-v7 Aksiniya/Ikhor wedding master; apply in its unsaved working copy before the builder saves a new revision.

ramp.unchanged: Existing key-facing combined response, geometric form, face-form floor 0.60, one short AO and their calibrated ranges are retained. No final face brightness floor.

white_outer.semantics: Artist-selected low-chroma/high-value permission from original base-texture Color in the current linear shader domain, multiplied by exclusions from unchanged source gold/cyan masks. Not a recovered game material map; dark lining and colored decorations retain their original branches.

rim.semantics: White-cloth changes are permission-gated per pixel. Original cyan-gem emission, gold/blue masks and other material rims retain their original sources; RGB chromatic splitting seen in the reference is not copied.

limits: Candidate adaptation from four user-provided local reference frames, not the author's shader or recovered render parameters.
All palette numbers are linear multipliers of the retained MMD Color output, not sampled display-sRGB swatches.
The face uses the existing original FaceDiffuse fallback because edited y1.png is missing; no texture is replaced or claimed restored.
No new emission closure, lighting probe, AO, real-time physics, camera, motion, geometry, outline, exposure, world or stage changes.
AOV names and original Alpha links stay intact; changed highlight/rim scalar signals automatically feed the existing beauty and AOV branches.
Four switches at zero structurally select the retained baseline branches; pixel-equivalent bypass and visual improvement require render controls.
Iteration 1 all-off GPU control differed from baseline by at most one 8-bit code value (MAE 0.0044618 code values); iteration 2 has not yet been rendered.

White midtone gain is multiplicative on the existing shaded NPR color before its original AO. It is gated by palette enable, unchanged white HSV permission and luminance headroom; it adds no constant white floor, gamma remap or emission closure. Already bright whites retain less gain. Physical BaseColor and its 12% cloth closure stay untouched.
White HSV permission must be checked on actual materials/UV before visual acceptance; high-value desaturated painted details may also enter the permission.
